lines.text: In this town... nobody jumps.
Not on trampolines. Not over puddles. Not even on your birthday.
Citizens of Geraldville!
Jumping is chaos. Jumping is disrespectful to the ground. And the ground has done NOTHING wrong.
Anyone caught jumping will be sent... to the Shadow Realm.
...the Shadow Realm is just Ohio.
SILENCE, Dave.
For forty years, nobody jumped. The town was peaceful. Quiet. Extremely... flat.
Until one day... a new kid moved in.
Hi! I'm Jaxon! What's up, everybody?
Sweetie... we don't say "up" here.
O-kay...
Kid. That's a puddle. Walk around it. Slowly.
Why? I can just...
*GASP*
He... he JUMPED!
The bread knows. The bread KNOWS.
WHO. JUMPED.
Me? It was literally just a puddle.
Young man, do you know what you've done?
Moved my legs... upward?
We do NOT say that word here!
What, legs?
...the other one.
Okay, but WHY can't anyone jump?
Because... forty years ago... I tried to jump.
And I couldn't. My hat... was too heavy.
So I banned it. For everyone. Forever.
That is the dumbest thing I have ever heard.
Watch.
...I mean... it DOES look kind of fun.
Oh, what the heck!
And one by one... the town remembered how to jump.
No! NO! Stop that! I am the MAYOR!
...fine. FINE. Without the hat, then.
Mayor Gerald was never seen again.
Some say he's still going up.
New law, everybody.
In this town... NO HATS.
YAAAY!
